title: Wrong session id shown after resuming a session

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: When resuming a session via `gemini --resume <session-id>`, executing `/stats session` afterwards displays a newly generated Session ID created at startup rather than the resumed session's ID.
summary.root_cause: `SessionStatsProvider` and downstream telemetry/logging utilities relied on a static module-level `sessionId` constant exported from `@google/gemini-cli-core` (generated via `randomUUID()` at module load time) that was never updated when a session was resumed.
summary.context: Config stores the resumed session ID, but UI context providers (`SessionStatsProvider`), logger hooks (`useLogger`), bug commands (`bugCommand`), and telemetry trace spans (`runInDevTraceSpan`) did not retrieve the session ID dynamically from configuration.

steps: Remove the static `sessionId` constant export from `packages/core/src/utils/session.ts` and `packages/core/src/index.ts`, keeping `createSessionId()`.

Update `runInDevTraceSpan` in `packages/core/src/telemetry/trace.ts` to require a `sessionId` string parameter in span options, and update caller sites (`loggingContentGenerator.ts`, `subagent-tool.ts`, `scheduler.ts`, `tool-executor.ts`, `useGeminiStream.ts`) to inject `config.getSessionId()`.

Refactor `SessionStatsProvider` in `packages/cli/src/ui/contexts/SessionContext.tsx` to take `sessionId` as a component prop, and update `interactiveCli.tsx` to pass `config.getSessionId()` to `SessionStatsProvider`.
Add `resolveSessionId(resumeArg)` helper in `packages/cli/src/gemini.tsx` to resolve the resumed session ID or generate a new session ID prior to startup.
Refactor `useLogger` in `packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/useLogger.ts` and `AppContainer.tsx` to take `config: Config` and instantiate `Logger` using `config.getSessionId()`.
Update `bugCommand` in `packages/cli/src/ui/commands/bugCommand.ts` to display `config?.getSessionId()` instead of importing the static `sessionId`.
Update `SessionSelector` in `packages/cli/src/utils/sessionUtils.ts`, `acpClient.ts`, and `sessions.ts` to accept `Storage` directly instead of `Config`.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: `SessionStatsProvider` uses the passed active session ID prop and correctly exposes it through `useSessionStats`, ensuring `/stats session` displays the resumed session ID.
verification_steps: Render `SessionStatsProvider` with a mock `sessionId="test-session-id"` prop in test harnesses.
Verify `useSessionStats()` context returns `sessionId` matching the prop.
Run `gemini --resume <session-id>` and run `/stats session` to verify the displayed session ID matches the resumed session.
